newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender 3-year 6.17 pct govt notes on Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender 3-year 6.17 pct govt notes on Jan 13.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday it will tender its 14th issue of three-year Exchange Fund notes on January 13.
The HK$500 million notes carry a coupon of 6.17 percent per annum, with interest payable semi-annually in arrears.
The notes will mature on January 14, 2000.
An additional HK$100 million will be held as reserve by the HKMA for supply to market makers in the secondary market.
Settlement will take place on January 14, 1997, it said.
